وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني الهندسة الكهربائية مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة وسلامة الأنظمة الكهربائية. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في تشخيص وحل المشكلات الفنية. تحديد المخططات وتقدير كميات المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين المشاركين في أعمال التركيبات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التزامها بالمخططات الأولية والمواصفات الفنية المطلوبة. الصيانة والتشخيص يعد جزء أساسي من الدور هو ضمان استمرارية عمل الأنظمة الكهربائية من خلال الصيانة الدورية والتدخل السريع عند الأعطال. تشمل المهام في هذا الجانب ما يلي: القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية كجزء من أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل في المكونات الكهربائية واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة لتحديد سبب المشكلة. تشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها لضمان الأداء الأمثل. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح الخبرات والمؤهلات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو الصيانة الكهربائية. فهم قوي لمبادئ التركيب والصيانة والاختبار للأنظمة الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الفنية. بيئة العمل سيعمل فني الهندسة الكهربائية بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تقديم خدمات الصيانة والتشغيل عالية الجودة. يتطلب الدور القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق، مع الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذا الدور في شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل.

6234d17fe2bc7b16.description: About Daikin Saudi Daikin Saudi is a subsidiary of Daikin Industries Ltd., a global provider of heating, cooling, ventilation, air purification, and refrigeration technology. The company designs, manufactures, and supplies equipment and tailored solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial applications across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). Daikin EMEA operates with over 12,000 employees, 59 consolidated subsidiaries, and 12 major manufacturing facilities. About the Role: HVAC Operator - Industrial Refrigeration The HVAC Operator - Industrial Refrigeration is responsible for the installation, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of HVAC systems. This full-time position is based in Al Dar Al Baida District, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires hands-on technical expertise to ensure reliable system operation and high customer satisfaction. The operator will execute service activities independently on-site while coordinating with supervisors and service teams to meet contractual service level agreements (SLAs) and operational targets. Key Responsibilities Perform installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of various systems, including Air-Cooled Chillers, Centrifugal Chillers, VRV & DX systems, Industrial Refrigeration (Ammonia Plant), and Commercial Refrigeration. Diagnose electrical, mechanical, and control faults, and implement corrective actions efficiently. Support commissioning, operation, and maintenance activities to ensure systems operate according to OEM standards. Identify root causes of system issues to minimize repeat breakdowns and optimize system performance through proper servicing, parameter checks, and minor adjustments. Escalate complex or recurring technical issues to supervisors as needed. Act as the on-site technical representative, maintaining professional communication with customers and explaining service activities, findings, and recommendations clearly. Complete service reports, checklists, and job documentation accurately and on time, recording system data, faults, and actions taken. Coordinate with supervisors, planners, and spare parts teams for smooth execution of tasks. Adhere to all safety procedures, PPE requirements, and permit systems, ensuring safe handling of tools, equipment, and refrigerants. Stay updated on product knowledge, service practices, and new HVAC technologies, participating in trainings and applying learning in field activities. Qualifications and Requirements Technical Diploma (ITI / Diploma in Mechanical, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or equivalent). Minimum of 2-5 years of hands-on experience in HVAC service, with a focus on installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting, specifically in Industrial Refrigeration. Strong troubleshooting skills in electrical and refrigeration systems. Basic knowledge of HVAC controls and schematic reading. Ability to work independently at customer sites. Good communication and customer-handling skills. Familiarity with service reporting tools (manual or digital). Strong commitment to safety and quality standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring on-site service execution at customer locations. The role involves close coordination with supervisors and service teams.

62410b5e22d14919.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Senior MEP Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves supporting the PMCM team by overseeing MEP systems for roads, tunnels, and associated infrastructure projects. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Provide MEP technical oversight and governance across all roads, tunnels, utilities, and structures packages within the program. Act as the PMO focal point for all MEP-related matters, ensuring alignment between design consultants, contractors, and stakeholders. Review and provide technical assurance for MEP designs, including tunnel ventilation, power supply, lighting, firefighting systems, drainage pumping, SCADA, utility diversions, and control systems. Ensure MEP systems comply with local authority requirements, relevant international standards, and RCRC design criteria. Lead and support design reviews, constructability assessments, and value engineering workshops for MEP systems. Identify, manage, and mitigate MEP-related technical, interface, and delivery risks at the program level. Coordinate interfaces among MEP systems and civil, structural, ITS, traffic, and utility disciplines. Support the PMO in preparation of technical reports, decision papers, dashboards, and executive summaries related to MEP scope. Guide MEP commissioning strategy, testing, operational readiness, and handover, particularly for tunnel and critical infrastructure systems. Review contractors’ method statements, material submittals, shop drawings, and inspection and test plans (ITPs) related to MEP works. Support cost, schedule, and change management processes by providing MEP technical inputs and impact assessments. Liaise with authorities, utility providers, and stakeholders to support approvals and coordination activities. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and discipline specialists within the PMO structure. Promote safety in design, sustainability, resilience, and lifecycle performance of MEP systems across the program. Required Qualifications and Skills Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. 6 years of progressive experience in MEP engineering on large-scale roads, tunnels, and infrastructure projects. Chartered Engineer (CEng) or equivalent internationally recognized professional registration. Demonstrated experience in tunnel MEP systems, including ventilation, power distribution, lighting, life safety, firefighting, drainage, and control systems. Strong understanding of MEP systems associated with roads and urban infrastructure, including utilities corridors and interface management. Proven experience working within PMO or program-level roles on major infrastructure programs. Knowledge of international and regional standards relevant to roads and tunnels MEP systems (*, NFPA, IEC, BS, EN, and local Saudi authority standards). Experience in design management, technical assurance, and multidisciplinary coordination. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging with senior stakeholders. Familiarity with smart roads infrastructure and digital integration. PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification. 62b4ab7daf03f84f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كرم الوطن عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة حفر الباطن. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وصيانة المعدات. نظرة عامة على المسؤوليات يتولى المهندس الكهربائي مسؤولية شاملة تبدأ من مرحلة التصميم والتخطيط وصولاً إلى متابعة التنفيذ والصيانة الوقائية. يشمل ذلك إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية وتشخيص الأعطال لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. المهام الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة إجراءات الصيانة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

62ca492637938435.description: About the Role Leylaty Group is seeking a dedicated Commis Chef – Saudi Cuisine to join its culinary team in Makkah, with operations also extending to Jeddah. This full-time role is ideal for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are passionate about authentic Saudi dishes and committed to maintaining high standards of food quality, safety, and hygiene. Key Responsibilities Assist in the preparation and production of Saudi dishes, adhering to standard recipes. Prepare and organize ingredients and mise en place for daily kitchen operations. Support the Chef de Partie and Demi Chef de Partie in daily kitchen activities. Aid in preparing traditional Saudi ingredients, sauces, and various dishes. Ensure consistent food quality and proper portioning. Maintain cleanliness and organization of the workstation and kitchen equipment. Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and HACCP standards at all times. Properly store ingredients and prepared products following FIFO procedures. Assist with stock rotation and efforts to minimize food waste. Support the kitchen team during service periods and busy production times. Handle kitchen equipment safely and according to established procedures. Collaborate with the culinary team to ensure smooth daily operations. Perform other duties as assigned by the Chef de Partie, Sous Chef, or Kitchen Management. Qualifications and Experience A qualification in Culinary Arts or a related field is preferred. 1–2 years of culinary experience is considered an advantage. Basic knowledge of Saudi cuisine and cooking techniques. Basic understanding of food safety and hygiene standards. Required Skills Ability to follow recipes and instructions accurately. Strong teamwork and communication skills. Willingness to learn and develop culinary skills. Attention to detail and commitment to quality. Work Environment This role operates within a fast-paced kitchen environment. Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays as required is essential for this position. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications and are interested in contributing to our culinary team are encouraged to apply.

629e6b18d1a6a136.description: Sales Executive — Wholesale Flowers Company: District Flowers Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Schedule: Must be available to work evening shifts on weekends as part of the agreed work schedule. About the Role District Flowers is looking for a proactive, commercially driven sales professional who can find customers, create opportunities, and close profitable orders. Your primary responsibility will be generating revenue through outbound prospecting, cold calling, structured follow-up, and activating our existing customer database. You will develop B2B accounts and larger B2C opportunities across wholesale flowers, occasions, and gifting. You will own the sales process from first contact through confirmed order and repeat business, using our CRM to manage opportunities, register customers, and build custom orders. Success requires initiative, confident communication, disciplined follow-up, and close coordination with the team. Key Responsibilities Outbound Sales and Lead Generation Identify and approach potential customers, including flower shops, gifting businesses, event planners, corporate buyers, and hospitality accounts. Make cold calls, send targeted WhatsApp messages, and conduct sales visits to generate qualified opportunities. Reach decision-makers, understand purchasing needs, and present relevant products and services. Use our customer database and order history to reactivate dormant customers and identify repeat-purchase opportunities. Proactively develop larger B2C orders for private occasions, gatherings, and gifting. Sales Conversion and Account Development Manage opportunities from qualification through quotation, negotiation, and closing. Establish customer requirements, quantities, budgets, and delivery timelines. Prepare accurate quotations and build custom orders through District’s sales platform. Handle objections and negotiate within approved pricing, discount, and commercial terms. Secure order confirmation and payment or approved credit arrangements. Register B2B and B2C customers and convert registrations into active purchasing relationships. Grow customer accounts through timely follow-up, relevant recommendations, and seasonal planning. CRM and Pipeline Management Maintain accurate customer profiles and sales records. Document outreach, conversations, quotations, objections, and agreed next steps. Keep opportunity stages, expected order values, and anticipated closing dates current. Ensure every active opportunity has a clear next action and scheduled follow-up. Use customer lists, filters, and purchase history to prioritize outreach. Report on pipeline progress, sales results, and reasons for lost opportunities. Product Availability and Sourcing Stay informed about available stock, incoming shipments, product varieties, and pricing. Coordinate with the purchasing lead and contact approved wholesalers when internal stock is insufficient. Confirm product availability, quality, cost, and lead times, obtaining approval before making purchasing commitments. Recommend suitable alternatives that meet customer requirements and protect profitability. Confirm sourcing and fulfilment arrangements before making promises to customers.

62d46171be0f2576.job_title: Commercial Education Manager MEA Johnson & Johnson MedTech
62d46171be0f2576.description: About the Role Panda Retail Company, part of Savola Group, is seeking a Commercial Excellence Senior Manager to lead and embed a Commercial Excellence framework. This full-time position is based in Jeddah and is responsible for defining and driving best-in-class commercial standards, capabilities, and performance management practices. The role aims to enhance revenue growth, optimize margins, and improve execution effectiveness across the organization. Role Purpose and Impact The Commercial Excellence Senior Manager will strengthen commercial decision-making through analytics, governance, capability building, and continuous improvement. This involves ensuring alignment between strategy, category execution, pricing, promotions, and customer value delivery. The role is central to improving financial performance and operational efficiency within the commercial functions. Key Responsibilities Develop the Commercial Excellence strategy and annual operating plan to support sustainable revenue growth and margin optimization. Define and monitor commercial performance targets, KPIs, and scorecards for disciplined financial performance management. Analyze category, pricing, promotion, and margin performance to identify value leakage and growth opportunities. Support commercial budgeting and forecasting processes to improve accuracy and financial predictability. Evaluate the financial impact of commercial initiatives and transformation programs to ensure ROI. Lead the Commercial Excellence team, setting objectives and developing capabilities. Develop commercial capability frameworks and training programs (*, category management, pricing, promotions, negotiation, analytics). Coach commercial leaders and teams to embed best practices and strengthen execution discipline. Ensure commercial strategies align with customer needs, behaviors, and value perception. Translate customer insights and market trends into commercial standards and playbooks. Support omnichannel commercial execution for consistent pricing, assortment, and promotion experiences. Monitor the impact of commercial decisions on customer KPIs. Develop commercial playbooks, tools, and methodologies (*, category reviews, promo effectiveness, price ladders). Establish performance review cadences and forums to track execution and drive continuous improvement. Drive data-driven decision-making by integrating analytics and insights into commercial planning. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across commercial processes. Ensure alignment of commercial processes with corporate governance, risk, and compliance requirements. Prepare and present periodic Commercial Excellence performance and insight reports to support executive decision-making. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in commercial excellence, strategy, or a related field. Demonstrated ability to lead and embed commercial frameworks within an organization. Strong analytical skills with experience in performance management and data-driven decision-making. Experience in developing and delivering capability building programs. Collaboration and Culture The role requires strong collaboration across Commercial, Supply Chain, Marketing, Pricing, and Operations teams to ensure alignment and shared ownership of results. The Senior Manager will promote a performance-driven, insight-led culture to enhance ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the commercial functions.

62e4ffdac5aa1e1b.description: About the HR Amazon Operations Internship Amazon is seeking motivated and innovative HR Generalist Interns to contribute to its global workforce. This full-time internship, located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offers the opportunity to work on projects that impact employees and business success while learning from HR professionals. Interns will develop core HR competencies and gain hands-on experience across various human resources functions within a fast-paced, global environment. Internship Overview This internship provides immersion in HR within a global organization. Interns may work on projects in areas such as employee relations, training, or compensation. The role allows for the application of analytical, problem-solving, and technical skills, alongside the development of communication and other professional soft skills through practical experience. Interns will gain insights into how HR partners with the business to drive growth and organizational excellence, establishing a foundation for an HR career. Key Responsibilities Develop in-depth knowledge of HR functions within Amazon's operations. Assist with internal communication efforts to align teams across multiple countries. Help develop training plans and materials to address evolving development needs. Learn about HR functions across the broader Amazon organization and stay updated on best practices. Provide support to Amazon employees on daily queries related to attendance, engagement, compensation, and other HR matters. Assist HR teams with day-to-day operational routines and administrative tasks. Participate in process reviews to identify opportunities for simplification and automation. Compile comprehensive personnel statistics, reports, and performance evaluations. Partner with business leaders to align HR strategies and initiatives with organizational goals. Required Qualifications Strong analytical capabilities. Excellent communication skills. A data-driven approach to problem-solving. The right to work in the country of employment by the start date. Work Environment and Duration The internship length is 3 to 6 months, full-time. Successful interns may be considered for a graduate role upon completion of their university studies. Company Culture Amazon fosters a culture of ownership and excellence, aiming to be the most customer-centric company globally. This internship positions individuals at the intersection of people and business strategy within an innovative company environment.

621ebf8c23d551cd.description: About La Petite Maison (LPM) La Petite Maison (LPM) operates Le Café LPM, a casual dining destination inspired by the French Riviera. The focus is on quality food, a welcoming atmosphere, and attention to detail in service. This full-time Receiving Clerk position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. Role Summary The Receiving Clerk is responsible for managing all incoming goods for Le Café LPM. This role ensures the accuracy and quality of deliveries from the initial point of receipt, playing a critical part in maintaining operational standards and inventory integrity. The position reports directly to the Purchasing Officer. Key Responsibilities Verify all incoming deliveries against purchase orders, checking quantities, temperatures, and overall quality. Reject any goods that do not meet established quality or quantity standards. Ensure all food items are handled, stored, and labelled in full compliance with food safety standards. Accurately record all deliveries, invoices, credit notes, and discrepancies. Maintain clean and organized receiving logs for purchasing and accounting records. Move received goods to appropriate storage areas (fridges, freezers, dry stores) following the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle. Ensure all storage areas are kept clean, organized, and correctly labelled. Communicate any issues or discrepancies without delay to the relevant team members. Candidate Profile We are seeking a meticulous and reliable individual with a keen eye for detail. The ideal candidate will be proactive in identifying and flagging issues early, ensuring that all incoming goods meet the required standards. A strong sense of responsibility and punctuality is essential for this role. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a similar receiving or inventory control role. Demonstrated ability to perform thorough quality checks and accurate record-keeping. Understanding of food safety handling and storage principles. Work Environment This is a full-time position within a dynamic hospitality environment. Flexibility is a core value at Le Café LPM, and team members may be asked to support other departments as business needs require. The role demands consistent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high operational standards.

622c30397e0f7896.description: المسمى الوظيفي: بائع الهدف من الوظيفة: دعم العمليات اليومية وتحقيق التميز في خدمة العملاء داخل المعرض، مع الالتزام بسياسات الشركة والمحافظة على النظافة العامة والمظهر الجيد وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية: تقديم خدمة عملاء مميزة والحفاظ على روح التعاون مع أعضاء الفريق. المساهمة في رفع مبيعات الفرع من خلال متابعة تحقيق الأهداف الشهرية ومقارنتها بالفترة نفسها من العام السابق. الالتزام بساعات العمل الرسمية وبلبس الزي الموحد المعتمد من الشركة. المحافظة على نظافة وتنظيم المعرض في جميع الأوقات. ضمان عدم وجود مخالفات حكومية من خلال الالتزام بجميع التعليمات التشغيلية. متابعة شكاوى العملاء والعمل على تقليلها من خلال تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة. المتطلبات: مهارات تواصل فعال ومهارات البيع الالتزام، حسن المظهر وروح الفريق أيام العمل : 6 أيام في الاسبوع الإجازة الاسبوعية: يوم واحد (تكون الإجازة في وسط الاسبوع وليس في الويكيند) العمل بدوام كامل (8 ساعات) (يتم التعيين على شفت واحد سواء مسائي أو صباحي) ☀️ الشفت الصباحي 9 الصباح - 5 المساء 🌙الشفت المسائي 4 مساء - 12 منتصف الليل يمكن أن يتم التنقل بين الفروع القريبة هذه الوظيفة تتطلب استخراج بطاقة صحية (شهادة صحية) بعد التعيين

62496913e004961d.description: نبحث عن مهندس موقع تشطيبات ذو خبرة للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في إنجاز المشاريع بكفاءة واحترافية. ستكون مسؤولاً عن الإشراف على جميع مراحل أعمال التشطيبات وضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير المطلوبة. إذا كنت تمتلك المهارات القيادية والخبرة الفنية في هذا المجال، ندعوك للتقديم. * الإشراف على سير العمل في مواقع التشطيبات والتأكد من الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية. * مراقبة جودة المواد المستخدمة والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. * التنسيق مع فرق العمل والمقاولين لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. * حل أي مشاكل فنية قد تطرأ في الموقع وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. * إعداد التقارير الدورية عن تقدم العمل وتكاليف المشروع. شرط خريج جامعه حكومية خبرة من 5 الي 10 سنوات

62f9e3a6db724e42.description: About Penta Consulting Penta Consulting is a technology service provider that delivers professional and managed solutions across EMEA. The company operates as a leading outsourced partner in the technology sector. The Role of Senior Network Engineer Penta Consulting is seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer to support a large-scale, complex network environment in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on Data Centre networking, Enterprise Routing & Switching, Network Security, Automation, and troubleshooting critical network issues. The successful candidate will be heavily involved in operational support, complex incident resolution, root cause analysis, and network maintenance activities. Key Responsibilities Troubleshoot and resolve critical network outages and complex technical issues. Provide escalation support for Severity 1 & 2 incidents. Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and recommend corrective actions. Support critical maintenance windows, upgrades, and network changes. Collaborate with customer technical teams to improve network performance and stability. Required Experience Candidates for this position should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant network engineering role, with a strong background in Data Centre networking, Enterprise Routing & Switching, Network Security, and Automation. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic environment that requires proactive problem-solving and collaboration with technical teams. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be discussed with qualified candidates.

625aa1ea997d6c45.description: About the Role Match is seeking a Store Supervisor to ensure the smooth daily operation of its retail store in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role acts as a crucial link between management and staff, focusing on achieving sales goals, maintaining high customer satisfaction, and overseeing staff, inventory, and store standards. Key Responsibilities Oversee and manage the daily functioning of the store, including opening and closing procedures and ensuring adherence to company policies. Monitor sales performance, identify trends, and implement strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Ensure all customers receive excellent service and handle complaints, inquiries, and issues professionally. Monitor stock levels, order new products, process shipments, conduct stock counts, and maintain accurate inventory records to prevent stockouts and losses. Ensure the store is clean, organized, and visually appealing with proper displays and signage. Prepare work schedules and delegate tasks to team members to ensure proper coverage and productivity. Recruit, hire, train, coach, and motivate store staff to improve their performance and skills. Monitor staff performance, provide feedback, and conduct performance reviews. Implement and enforce security measures to protect employees, customers, and store assets. Maintain accurate records, including sales reports and expense reports, and manage cash handling procedures. Perform any work requested by the direct manager. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for the Store Supervisor position should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in retail operations and supervision. The role requires a strong understanding of retail management principles and practices. Required Skills Demonstrated ability to manage daily store operations effectively. Strong leadership and team management capabilities, including staff recruitment, training, and performance evaluation. Proficiency in sales monitoring, trend identification, and strategy implementation to achieve targets. Excellent customer service skills, with the ability to handle inquiries and resolve complaints professionally. Competence in inventory management, including stock control, ordering, and record-keeping. Attention to detail in maintaining store cleanliness, organization, and visual merchandising standards. Ability to prepare work schedules and delegate tasks efficiently. Knowledge of security measures to protect assets and personnel. Accuracy in maintaining records, preparing reports, and managing cash handling procedures. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a retail store setting. The role involves direct interaction with staff and customers, requiring a proactive and hands-on approach to store management. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

627149a65b4b9a37.job_title: 1. مهندس تقدير التكاليف للمشاريع / Tendering & Cost Estimation Manager
627149a65b4b9a37.description: About the Role Outdoor Factory Middle East & Africa (ODF) is expanding its presence in Saudi Arabia and is establishing an in-house estimating and tendering capability. We are seeking an Estimating & Tendering Manager to lead this function from Riyadh. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves significant ownership in managing the tender process and providing accurate cost positions for complex, design-led projects. Role Context and Impact The Estimating & Tendering Manager will be responsible for developing complete, traceable, and realistic cost positions for high-end fit-out, theming, and specialist projects. This role involves direct collaboration with Procurement and the Pre-Construction lead, influencing work packaging and pricing strategies. The successful candidate will contribute to securing tenders by providing commercial insight, challenging quantities and quotations, understanding construction methodologies, and identifying potential cost risks. Key Responsibilities Analyze ITT documents, BOQs, drawings, specifications, and addenda to identify omissions, inconsistencies, and scope gaps. Conduct high-accuracy quantity spot checks and develop detailed rate build-ups covering labor, materials, plant, logistics, installation, and testing. Price preliminaries, mobilization, temporary works, mock-ups, and close-out requirements, translating program and methodology into cost. Define tender packaging strategies and prepare RFP packages, Scope Responsibility Matrices, and Scopes of Work. Evaluate subcontractor and supplier quotations for technical and commercial completeness, ensuring bids are directly comparable. Coordinate closely with Procurement throughout the RFQ process. Maintain assumptions, exclusions, and a cost-risk register with appropriate allowances. Support value engineering and alternative materials, methods, and sourcing. Prepare cost summaries and management review reports, and contribute to building the historical cost and benchmarking database. Lead technical briefings and pre-bid meetings, support post-tender clarifications, and provide a structured cost handover upon award. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in estimating and tendering. Demonstrated ability to analyze full project scopes, challenge quantities and quotations, and understand construction processes. Proven capability in identifying and mitigating cost risks. Strong commercial acumen and analytical skills. Work Environment and Opportunities This is a senior, high-visibility position within a growing regional contractor based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role offers exposure to premium, design-led, and specialist projects, along with close collaboration with Procurement and Pre-Construction leadership. It provides a significant opportunity to build and shape the tendering function for Outdoor Factory Middle East & Africa in Saudi Arabia.

6273e1c4b10fd38e.description: About the Role Acwa is seeking a Document Controller to join their team in Al Madinah, with locations in Yanbu and Medina. This full-time role is essential for maintaining, examining, and managing all critical project documents, ensuring their accessibility and proper storage through dedicated monitoring systems. Role Overview The Document Controller provides comprehensive support for project documentation. This involves overseeing project document control, communication, and schedule monitoring systems to ensure all information is accurately maintained, easily accessible, and securely stored throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Set up and maintain the Project Communication System provided by the EPC Contractor, including internal distribution, archiving, and storage of all incoming and outgoing correspondence. Establish and maintain the Project Document Control System supplied by the EPC Contractor, encompassing live archiving and storage of all project information and documents. Monitor the EPC Contractor's Schedule Monitoring System. Ensure all company documentation is properly filed, both hard and electronic copies, with tracking logs kept up to date. Assist the project team in searching and retrieving documents and information within the systems. Provide management tools such as Status Reports, Input Audit Reports, and any other monitoring reports required by the Project Director, Construction Manager, and QA/QC Manager. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in document control or a related field. Demonstrated high level of concentration and attention to detail and accuracy when entering data, numbers, and titles into systems. Working knowledge and experience with various types of filing systems. Required Skills Good communication and interpersonal skills. Proficiency in standard office software, including Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, and PowerPoint. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time Document Controller position with Acwa.

627bc1504bc903bd.description: About the Role St. Regis is seeking a Spa Receptionist to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position is open to Saudi nationals only and requires 0-1 years of experience. The Spa Receptionist will be responsible for managing information, handling guest inquiries, and supporting general office operations within the spa environment. Key Responsibilities Enter and retrieve information from computer databases to update records, files, and reservations. Answer guest inquiries and transmit information or documents using various office equipment. Operate standard office equipment, including computers, mail, and facsimile machines. Prepare letters, memos, and other documents using word processing, spreadsheet, database, or presentation software. Handle incoming and outgoing mail, including date stamping and distribution. Create and maintain computer- and paper-based filing and organization systems for records, reports, and documents. Compile, copy, sort, and file records of office activities and business transactions. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Guest Services and Professional Conduct Follow all company policies and procedures, ensuring a clean and professional appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipating and addressing their service needs. Assist individuals with disabilities and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Communicate clearly and professionally with guests and colleagues. Prepare and review written documents accurately and completely. Answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Team Collaboration and Physical Requirements Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support the team in achieving common goals. Listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. About St. Regis St. Regis Hotels & Resorts delivers exquisite experiences at over 50 luxury hotels and resorts globally. The brand is known for its bespoke and anticipatory service, including signature Butler Service, provided by a team that combines classic sophistication with modern sensibility. St. Regis is part of the Marriott International portfolio of brands. Commitment to Diversity Marriott International is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an environment where the unique backgrounds, cultures, talents, and experiences of all associates are valued and celebrated.
